Image support data (ISD) fixtures from usgscsm's test data
(https://github.com/DOI-USGS/usgscsm, `tests/data`), which is in the public domain (CC0 1.0):

- `orbitalLineScan.json`: a synthetic 16 x 16 line scanner in a circular orbit.
- `ctxLineScan.json`: Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter's Context Camera (CTX).
- `toughLroNacLineScan.json`: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter's Narrow Angle Camera (NAC, left),
  2 x 2 summed.
